008package paint.viewer.ui;
009
010import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
011
012import java.util.List;
013
014/**
015 * Handles safe navigation through a list of recordings.
016 * {@link paint.viewer.ui.frames.ViewerFrame} registers as the listener and
017 * updates the UI whenever a new index is selected.
018 */
019public final class RecordingNavigator {
020
021    /**
022     * Listener interface for responding to navigation events.
023     */
024    public interface Listener {
025        /**
026         * Called when a navigation action requires shifting to a new recording.
027         *
028         * @param newIndex the target index in the recording list
029         */
030        void onNavigateTo(int newIndex);
031    }
032
033    private final Listener listener;
034
035    /**
036     * Constructs a {@code RecordingNavigator} with the specified listener.
037     *
038     * @param listener the object to notify when navigation occurs
039     */
040    public RecordingNavigator(Listener listener) {
041        this.listener = listener;
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Navigates to the first recording in the list.
046     *
047     * @param entries the list of available recordings
048     */
049    public void first(List<RecordingEntry> entries) {
050        if (entries.isEmpty()) return;
051        listener.onNavigateTo(0);
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * Navigates to the last recording in the list.
056     *
057     * @param entries the list of available recordings
058     */
059    public void last(List<RecordingEntry> entries) {
060        if (entries.isEmpty()) return;
061        listener.onNavigateTo(entries.size() - 1);
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * Navigates to the next recording in the list.
066     *
067     * @param entries      the list of available recordings
068     * @param currentIndex the index of the currently displayed recording
069     */
070    public void next(List<RecordingEntry> entries, int currentIndex) {
071        if (entries.isEmpty()) return;
072        int next = Math.min(entries.size() - 1, currentIndex + 1);
073        listener.onNavigateTo(next);
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * Navigates to the previous recording in the list.
078     *
079     * @param entries      the list of available recordings
080     * @param currentIndex the index of the currently displayed recording
081     */
082    public void prev(List<RecordingEntry> entries, int currentIndex) {
083        if (entries.isEmpty()) return;
084        int prev = Math.max(0, currentIndex - 1);
085        listener.onNavigateTo(prev);
086    }
087}
